international.title: Alan Milburn says his plan to get young people into work will save only £200m a year
international.summary: Author of long-awaited report says money saved in benefit cuts will mostly be used to fund new job support system UK politics live – latest updates Neet ideas: what’s in Milburn’s report? Alan Milburn has said his plan to get more young people into work will save the government only £200m a year as the cost of job support swallows up almost all of the anticipated cuts to benefits. The former health secretary unveiled his long-awaited report into youth unemployment on Tuesday morning, urging ministers to cut disability and sickness payments for under-25s and invest the money in back-to-work schemes. Figures contained in the report show that his plan will not deliver significant overall savings. Continue reading...
